data.name: Fudail
data.gender_notes: Fudail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is faithful and righteous, a loyal and just person. The name Fudail carries the meaning “Faithful, Righteous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fudail usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful, righteous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is guided by the light of faith and righteousness.
data.etymology: Fudail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faithful, Righteous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fudail total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فُدَيْل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من فضل، يدل على القلة في الخير أو العمل
in_arabic.long_meaning: فُدَيْل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفضل، وهو يدل على القلة في الخير أو العمل. وقد ورد ذكر الفضل في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: {وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ} [الزلزلة: 7]. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي كاسم للعديد من الشخصيات، منهم فديل بن عبادة، الصحابي النجدي الذي كان معروفًا بكرمه وجوده.

in_urdu.name: فُدیل
in_urdu.meaning: فضل سے مشتق، خیر یا کام میں کمی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فُدیل ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے، جو فضل سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ خیر یا کام میں کمی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں فضل کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا فرمان: {وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ} [الزلزلة: 7]. اسلامی تاریخ میں یہ نام کئی شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوا ہے، جن میں فدیل بن عبادة، نجدی صحابی جو اپنے خیر و کرم کے لیے مشہور تھے، شامل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फुदैल
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ज़ल से व्युत्पन्न, अच्छे या काम में कमी को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फुदैल एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है, जो फ़ज़ल से व्युत्पन्न है। यह अच्छे या काम में कमी को दर्शाता है। कुरआन में फ़ज़ल का उल्लेख कई स्थानों पर किया गया है, जैसे कि अल्लाह का वचन: {وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ} [الزلزلة: 7]. इस्लामी इतिहास में यह नाम कई व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया गया है, जिनमें फुदैल बिन उबादा, नजदी सहाबी जो अपने खैर और उदारता के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे, शामिल हैं।

in_pashto.name: فدیل
in_pashto.meaning: د فضل څخه مشتق شوی، د خیر یا کار کمښت ته اشاره کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: فدیل یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي څخه مشتق شوی دی، چی د فضل څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د خیر یا کار کمښت ته اشاره کوي. قرآن کریم کې د فضل یادونه په ډیرو ځایونو کې شوې ده، لکه د الله تعالی فرمان: {وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ} [الزلزلة: 7]. په اسلامی تاریخ کې دا نوم د ډیرو شخصیتو لپاره استعمال شوی دی، په هغو کښې فدیل بن عبادة، نجدی صحابي چی د خپل خیر او کرم لپاره مشهور و، شامل دي.

in_english.name: Fudail
in_english.meaning: Derived from Fadl, indicating a little or some good
in_english.long_meaning: Fudail is a masculine name of Arabic origin, derived from 'Fadl', which means a little or some good. The term 'Fadl' is mentioned in several verses of the Quran, such as {وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ} [الزلزلة: 7]. Historically, this name has been used for several personalities in Islamic tradition, including Fudayl bin Ubadah, a renowned Najdi companion known for his generosity and benevolence. The name signifies virtues like modesty and humility, reflecting a balanced approach to life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fudail carries a deep cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is a reminder of the importance of faithfulness, morality, and righteousness in daily life. In Islamic culture, personal names often reflect the values and aspirations of their parents or the wider community, and the name Fudail would be seen as a desirable choice for a child, inspiring them to uphold a life of integrity and justice.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fudail also holds great spiritual significance for Muslims, as it is a reflection of the noble character traits that are valued in Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) once said, "The most beloved of names to Allah are the names of the Prophets: 'Ali, 'Abdullah, and 'Abdul-Muttalib." (At-Tabaraani). The name Fudail, meaning 'faithful and righteous,' echoes these virtues and serves as a constant reminder of the importance of adhering to the teachings of Allah and striving for a pure and righteous character. It is a name that inspires its bearer to make a strong spiritual connection with Allah and to seek His guidance and pleasure in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Faithful, Righteous" symbolizes One who is faithful and righteous, a loyal and just person.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fudail serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of faithful, righteous.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fudail ibn Ayaz al-Ansari (d. 650 CE) was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Fudail carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fudail was a prominent Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad. He was born in the city of Kufa in Iraq and was known for his piety and asceticism. He was also a close companion of Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph of Islam.
